label: Ręczna aktualizacja Tour/TA
info: Ręczna aktualizacja zielonego daty trasy i TA na podstawie listy numerów

query:
DECLARE @lastRunTimestampUTC DATETIMEOFFSET = CAST('{{{timestamp}}}' AS DATETIMEOFFSET);
DECLARE @lastRunTimestampMEZ DATETIME2 = 
    CONVERT(datetime2, @lastRunTimestampUTC AT TIME ZONE 'Central European Standard Time');

SELECT
    O.Tour AS tour_set_name,
    O.STATUS_KEY AS tour_state_id,
    O.UPDATE_TS AS tour_update_ts,    
    OP.OrderID AS vbeln,
    CASE
        WHEN OP.QUANTITY_MISSING > 0 THEN 'Missing Items'
        WHEN OP.QUANTITY_DONE = OP.QUANTITY THEN 'Completed'
        WHEN OP.QUANTITY_DONE > 0 THEN 'In Progress'
        WHEN OP.QUANTITY_PREPARED = OP.QUANTITY THEN 'Prepared'
        WHEN OP.QUANTITY_PREPARED > 0 THEN 'Partially Prepared'
        ELSE 'Not Started'
    END AS vbeln_state,
    OP.UPDATE_TS AS vbeln_update_ts    
FROM
    [CP_Sorter].[dbo].[T3_ORDER] O
INNER JOIN
    [CP_Sorter].[dbo].[T3_ORDERPOS] OP
    ON O.ORDER_NO = OP.ORDER_NO
WHERE
    O.INSERT_TS > @lastRunTimestampMEZ or
    O.UPDATE_TS > @lastRunTimestampMEZ or
    OP.INSERT_TS > @lastRunTimestampMEZ or
    OP.UPDATE_TS > @lastRunTimestampMEZ
ORDER BY
    O.Tour, OP.OrderID;
